title: AXI4-Stream to Software
text: Stream AXI4 data from FPGA to software, 3 inputs, 3 outputs, {Data type} sets Data type of writer data; {Memory simulation} sets the simulation timing accuracy, {Memory selection} sets the between memory regions, {Region size (bytes)} sets the size of the allocated memory region, in bytes Read-only, {Number of buffers}, {Burst length}, {FIFO depth (number of bursts)} sets the depth of FIFO for data, {FIFO almost-full depth (number of bursts)} sets the depth of FIFO when backpressure, {Clock frequency (MHz)} sets the interconnect frequency of manager datapath, {Data width (bits)} sets the data width of manager datapath, {Dimensions}, {Sample time} sets the time interval of sampling, {Enable sample packing (last signal dimension as channel)} sets the pack data on the last dimension and {View performance plots} displays performance metrics. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: wrData
ports.summary: Writer data bus signal scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: done
ports.summary: Notification message of completed read scalar

ports.name: msg
ports.summary: Output data signal to software scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: wrCtrlOut
ports.summary: Writer control signal to data producer bus

params.name: Memory simulation
params.values: Set simulation timing accuracy Burst accurate (default) | Protocol accurate | Behavioral

params.name: Memory selection
params.values: Choose between memory regions PS memory (default) | PL memory

params.name: Region size (bytes)
params.values: Size of the allocated memory region, in bytes Read-only: calculated

params.name: Number of buffers
params.values: Number of buffers in region 8 (default) | integer

params.name: Burst length
params.values: Burst length for memory transactions 256 (default) | scalar

params.name: FIFO depth (number of bursts)
params.values: Depth of FIFO for data 8 (default) | scalar

params.name: FIFO almost-full depth (number of bursts)
params.values: Depth of FIFO when backpressure is asserted 6 (default) | scalar

params.name: Data width (bits)
params.values: Data width of manager datapath 64 (default) | scalar

params.name: Dimensions
params.values: Dimensions of input data signal 1 (default) | scalar | array

params.name: Data type
params.values: Data type of writer data uint32 (default) | double | single | int8 | int16 | int32 | int64 | uint8 | uint16 | uint64 | Boolean | fixed point

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Time interval of sampling 1 (default) | positive scalar | vector

params.name: Enable sample packing (last signal dimension as channel)
params.values: Pack data on the last dimension of the signal off (default) | on
